purpose: Determine exactly what a class-blind common terminal event adds to the frozen pilot, and propagate existing amplitudes without new quadrature. This is not a physical gravitational detector derivation.

provenance.theta_selection: theta=0 inherits the previously discussed diagnostic; its numerical results were already known, so no fresh blind preregistration is claimed.

retained: six labelled histories and their 1/6 amplitude weights
all original measures and quotient factors
separate inner-density atom and positive strata
immutable_inputs.common_boundary_statement: Both classes have the same induced order on P union A union R and use the same preparation and terminal packet. Their amplitudes are complex linear functionals on the same E. This supplies a mathematical pairing, not proof of indistinguishable physical environments.
immutable_inputs.sum_over_R_I_meaning: R and I specify terminal and internal variables in an amplitude with retained P/A preparation; they do not remove the initial boundary, its packets, or its integrations.
immutable_inputs.interior_record_choice: Retain the atom/positive I flag in this first comparison. Classical forgetting of that flag sums probabilities. Coherent fusion across its strata is an additional unassessed instrument change.
immutable_inputs.terminal_event: The inherited f0 is one fixed terminal matter packet. Its success event and I strata are not distinct geometric R events.

notation.state: rho is positive trace one on E; formulas for g use rho=|g><g| with ||g||_E=1

old_classical_instrument.label: THEOREM
old_classical_instrument.consequence: Dropping the displayed class label after the classical record has been formed leaves the class phase invisible.

coherence_model.label: CONDITIONAL_NEW_INSTRUMENT_ASSUMPTION
coherence_model.environment: For each s choose two normalized, preparation-independent environment vectors e_1s,e_2s.
coherence_model.gamma_domain: complex, |gamma_s|<=1; fixed independently of rho and g
coherence_model.nonidentifiability: The old classical CP instrument is invariant under independent phases of its four Kraus rows. It is also the measured-class reduction of coherent extensions with arbitrary environment overlaps. Therefore neither physical gamma_s nor the relative detector phase reference, hence no physical D_12,s, is identified by the old classical instrument. Existing complex amplitudes fix a computational convention only.
coherence_model.unknown_overlap_bound: With x_s=a_1s*rho*a_2s^dagger and q_cs=a_cs*rho*a_cs^dagger, |D_12,s|<=lambda^2*|x_s|<=lambda^2*sqrt(q_1s*q_2s). Hence the direct event probability lies between lambda^2*(q_1s+q_2s-2|x_s|) and lambda^2*(q_1s+q_2s+2|x_s|) when gamma is unspecified.

candidates.interpretation: Orthogonal unobserved class markers: reproduces old classical coarse-graining; no cross term.
Identical environment states with declared relative phase reference: maximal coherent class-blind candidate; not established by the pilot.
Partial coherence and an environment-induced phase; overlap magnitude and phase require independent physical specification.

coherence_model.input_dependence_warning: Selecting gamma separately to fit each input need not define a linear CP map and is outside this contract.
coherence_model.conditional_nonzero: A nonzero cross term requires gamma_s*a_1s*rho*a_2s^dagger to have a nonzero real part for the selected detector phase. A nonzero gamma alone does not guarantee a nonzero contribution at a particular phase.

direct_common_event_instrument.label: CONDITIONAL_EXISTENCE_THEOREM_ON_E
direct_common_event_instrument.environment_map: N_s(g)=lambda*[a_1s(g)*e_1s+a_2s(g)*e_2s], with common visible flag s; trace its environment to obtain the accepted outcome map
direct_common_event_instrument.new_failure: F_gamma=(I_E-Q_gamma)^(1/2), with a separate failure flag
direct_common_event_instrument.complete_positivity: Each N_s is a bounded linear operator on E; tracing its environment is CP. Adding the positive-square-root failure map makes the total map trace preserving on E.
direct_common_event_instrument.normalization_distinction: This is a separately declared new instrument. It is not deterministic erasure of the old orthogonal class register. Its gamma=1 C_s is sqrt(2) times the diagnostic plus-port Kraus row at theta=0, so its success rate and failure map generally change.
direct_common_event_instrument.scope: The bound here applies only to the inherited terminal f0; adding further terminal packets requires its own bound.

plus_minus_diagnostic.label: CONDITIONAL_COHERENT_REGISTER_DIAGNOSTIC
plus_minus_diagnostic.required_resource: A coherent, accessible class register before irreversible class measurement; partial environment marking is described by the same gamma_s.
plus_minus_diagnostic.operator_identity: sum_+/-s M_+/-s^dagger*M_+/-s=Q_old for gamma=1; the same accepted effect follows from the register/environment dilation for every allowed gamma_s
plus_minus_diagnostic.interpretation: Port-resolved interference is a coherence diagnostic. Summing the two ports cancels the cross term, so total success remains phase blind. These ports are not automatically geometric end-boundary records.

phase_covariance.label: THEOREM
phase_covariance.diagnostic_phase_alternative: If gamma is held as a physical overlap and the computational row convention changes, theta_s -> theta_s+chi_1s-chi_2s transports the detector coefficients. Use either an overlap transport or the corresponding detector transport, not both to compensate the same change.
phase_covariance.general_detector_transport: For an amplitude-row basis change D=diag(exp(i*chi_1),exp(i*chi_2)), the fixed physical readout has U -> U*D^dagger.
phase_covariance.meaning: The invariant is the full phase-referenced cross term. Rephasing amplitude rows while holding a convention-dependent detector matrix fixed changes the experiment.

allowed: interval propagation of the existing outward complex amplitude rectangles
kappa=0 by removing only the inherited gravity phases as a counterfactual action ablation
forbidden: fitting gamma or theta to maximize a desired source contrast
changing history weights or original packets
claiming fresh blind selection for an already inspected diagnostic
controlled_calculations.kappa_zero_label: Counterfactual removal of the F4 phases while holding matter amplitudes fixed; not a calibrated scan of Newton's constant.
report_all: conditional probabilities only when denominator is certified positive
intervals containing zero as unresolved rather than exact zero

physical_limits.T_reflection: Every T-independent class mixer retains the original global clock reflection; all original oriented one-current amplitudes remain zero.
physical_limits.gravity_claim: Conditional sensitivity to the finite action's relative F4 phase is not a demonstration of physical gravitational backreaction.
physical_limits.stop_rule: If no independent common detector/environment and phase reference can be justified, retain the result only as a conditional instrument theorem and gamma sensitivity bound. Do not infer a physical D12 or enlarge scans to manufacture one.
